verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Decisive Strike's silence into a Demacian Justice/Ignite combo around level 6; you win every trade where you force the stun side of Facebreaker and center him with Haymaker.

brief.thesis: Garen has no dash, no slow, and no stun of his own — Decisive Strike only silences on a landed auto, so Sett's Facebreaker stun is the only hard CC in the lane and it belongs to you. Garen's whole plan is to out-sustain you with Perseverance's regen between Judgment spins; Haymaker's true-damage center shreds through that regen instead of trading into it, which is exactly why the measured 51.3% win rate over 3983 games skews your way outside his level-6 execute window.

theirWindow.when: level 6+, his R and Ignite both up
theirWindow.what: Demacian Justice executes based on your missing health and Ignite denies the regen that normally bails you out. Play the wave from a distance when you're under roughly 50% and don't let him land a free Decisive Strike silence into it.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is down (8s CD)
yourWindow.what: Without Decisive Strike up he has no speed burst, no slow cleanse, and no silence, so he can't kite your Knuckle Down (Q) stick or interrupt your Haymaker (W) cast. Walk him down, land E (Facebreaker) for the stun, then dump both empowered Q autos.

start.why: Picked in 85.1% of these games at 51.6% win rate — the sustain and early AD let you match his auto-attack trades without flinching from Judgment's spin damage.

boots.why: 64.3% pick rate at 50.9% win rate — Garen's damage is almost entirely basic attacks and the Judgment spin, both physical, so Steelcaps directly blunts his only consistent damage source.

core.why: The slow on its active lets you stick through his one mobility tool (Decisive Strike's speed burst) so he can't just walk out of E range.

runes.keystoneWhy: The measured 52.9% win rate page runs this same keystone — stacking it through extended trades directly counters Garen's Perseverance regen, since you're healing off him while he's locked into a losing fight.

summoners.why: Run in 93.4% of these games at 51.8% win rate — Sett holds the solo-kill advantage here, and Ignite denies the Perseverance regen tick that Garen relies on to reset between your all-ins.

playing.title: Position for the stun, not the slow
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if Garen is pulled from the opposite side of another unit; in a clean 1v1 with nothing else nearby it just slows him. Fight near minions or a wall so he's sandwiched when you cast E.

playing.title: Bank Grit before you engage
playing.detail: Haymaker expends all stored Grit from damage you've taken, so tank a Judgment spin or an auto first, then cast W for the bigger shield and punch rather than using it on cooldown.

playing.title: Center him with Haymaker every time
playing.detail: The true damage hits only the center of the punch; walking him into the middle of your W bypasses his Perseverance regen entirely instead of trading into it.

playing.title: Approach with Q active
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's move speed only triggers while you're moving toward enemy champions, so pop it before closing distance rather than after he's already disengaging with Decisive Strike.

playing.title: Play passive from level 6 to 7
playing.detail: Demacian Justice plus Ignite can execute you off a missing-health percentage. Hold trades until you've confirmed his ultimate is down or you're above the threshold.

playing.title: Bait Decisive Strike before you all-in
playing.detail: His Q only silences if the empowered auto actually lands. Walk out of his 300-range window once it's clearly coming, then commit your own combo once it's spent on air.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning tying them together — stun positioning, Grit banking, W centering — is this brief's own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being killed when Garen reaches level 6 and uses his (R) - Ignite combo. Focus on farming lane and on hitting him at the center of [W] to gain the upper hand.
